greeting: Good morning, Zuhair. Grab a coffee, it's a big Saturday for tech news.

lead.headline: Jensen Huang steps down as Nvidia CEO
lead.summary: Nvidia's board announced on 12 November that Jensen Huang has resigned as president, CEO and director, effective immediately. CFO Colette Kress becomes interim CEO while the board searches for a permanent successor, and Harvey C. Jones is named its first-ever chair.

stories.headline: AI-agent-run lab automates DNA and biomolecular engineering
stories.summary: Published in Nature on 4 November, the AutoDNA system from Shanghai Jiao Tong University uses multiple AI agents that turn a plain-language request into code driving more than 20 lab instruments. It has drawn wide attention as a glimpse of autonomous labs, though humans still fixed some hardware faults.

stories.headline: Roadmap for ecologically meaningful foundation models
stories.summary: A Perspective in Nature Machine Intelligence (6 November) from Queen Mary University of London researchers argues for AI models trained on many kinds of ecological data at once. It is a roadmap rather than a new algorithm, and it flags data gaps and bias as key risks.

stories.headline: Google makes Gemini 4 Carbon generally available
stories.summary: Google has moved Gemini 4 Carbon from a restricted cyber-defender preview to wider availability for developers, enterprises and consumers. It is pitched as strong at cybersecurity and long-running projects.

stories.headline: Anthropic IPO reportedly heavily oversubscribed
stories.summary: Bloomberg-sourced reports say orders for Anthropic's Nasdaq listing exceed the shares on offer at a $70 to $78 range. Pricing is expected on 18 November, with trading as ANT the next day.

stories.headline: Anthropic IPO terms set at roughly US$1.2 trillion target
stories.summary: Renaissance Capital reports the terms of Anthropic's roughly US$61 billion offering, aimed at a market value above one trillion dollars.

stories.headline: Contractors say Allan's office urged them to 'bend the knee' to the CFMEU
stories.summary: Royal commission hearings into the Big Build heard claims about pressure on contractors over an industrial dispute. The claims are disputed and no wrongdoing has been found.

stories.headline: UN adviser criticises opposition plan to scrap Victoria's Treaty
stories.summary: The Victorian election campaign continues, with the ABC's live blog covering the Treaty debate and Labor's pledge of more frequent train services.

stories.headline: Bus shelter vandalism reports spike across Melbourne
stories.summary: Reports of vandalism at Melbourne bus stops have risen sharply, and the Department of Transport says it is cracking down, including with drones along train routes.

stories.headline: US-Iran tensions flare after claimed strike on radar in Bahrain
stories.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guard says it destroyed a US early-warning radar in Bahrain, which Washington denies, while Trump says a deal is not needed to end the war.

stories.headline: Ukraine talks: Europe to join next round, drone hits Russian warship
stories.summary: Zelensky says Europeans will join the next round of negotiations, though the Kremlin has not confirmed, and a Ukrainian drone reportedly hit a Russian warship in the Baltic.
